versions.content: If no NM-messages with an indication to keep the bus awake are received in the Normal Operation State for a configurable amount of time determined by the FrNmRemoteSleepIndTime, then the NM shall notify the Generic NM Interface module that all other nodes in the cluster are ready to sleep (the ‘Remote Sleep Indication’) by calling Nm_RemoteSleepIndication.
